verdict.rationale: ROS 2 clearly covers on-robot capture: rosbag recording via `ros2 bag` and a Python API for writing bags from your own nodes, which community users cite as a key benefit. QoS policies tune delivery over non-ideal networks, but nothing in the evidence shows syncing captured data to the cloud or bandwidth-aware upload policies. Missing for 10: cloud sync/upload mechanism, bandwidth-aware sync policies (throttling, prioritization, offline buffering), independent evidence of a robot-to-cloud pipeline.
